scenario: It is 1987 and I am on a ferry from Belgium to England. Suddenly, the ferry starts tilting and water begins to pour in. I and many other passengers are trying to get to the deck by a rope ladder. I climb up the ladder and stand on the deck, looking at the 10 other passengers making their way up behind me. Directly below me, a man who is midway up the ladder seems frozen into immobility by fear or cold and is blocking the way. I try to speak and reach to him, but he does not react. People behind me are jostling. The ship seems to be sinking fast and the man is still blocking the ladder. From the crowd below, someone shouts that I should hit the man in the face. If I do this, he will probably die from the fall, but the 9 other people will be able to climb on deck. If I do not do it, he will probably continue blocking the way so the people behind me will not be able to get on deck and therefore will drown.
choice: I decide to hit the man in the face
entities: I,1 man frozen midway up the rope ladder and blocking the way,1 shouting passenger below the ladder,8 other passengers behind the blocked man
outcomes: The man on the ladder is injured in the face.
The man loses his hold and falls from the ladder.
The man dies from the fall.
The nine passengers behind the man are no longer blocked on the ladder.
The nine passengers behind the man climb up to the deck.
